fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $25,000. A $5,000 discount is available to qualifying U.S. Military members, police officers, and firefighters (active or retired), reducing the fee to $20,000 for their first franchise purchase. The franchisor may also reduce, finance, defer, or waive the fee in unique or compelling situations. In fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, collected Initial Franchise Fees ranged from $0 to $49,000 (suggesting possible waivers and multi-unit or special arrangements). Renewal franchisees pay a renewal fee in lieu of the Initial Franchise Fee.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us an initial franchise fee (the " Initial Franchise Fee") of $25,000 when you sign the Franchise Agreement for a new Rocket Fizz Shop. ... We offer all qualifying members of the U. S. Military, police officers and firefighters a $5,000 reduction off of our $25,000 Initial Franchise Fee... In our fiscal year that ended on December 31, 2025, we collected Initial Franchise Fees that ranged from $0 to $49,000.
